title: The document cache keeps three maps — document promises, batch promises and listeners — so useDocuments returns a stable reference and Suspense does not thrash
description: It sits between React components and the reactor, caching promises rather than values so a duplicate fetch is deduplicated, subscribing to reactor events for automatic updates.
